reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI as blessing or curse
themes.definition: AI framed as a pivotal development that can become either a utopian blessing or a dystopian curse depending on choices made.
themes.inclusion: Include passages explicitly contrasting AI's promise with its perils (utopia/dystopia, blessing/curse).
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that list AI only as a field of cooperation or achievement.
themes.boundary_cases: Visionary lists of AI benefits that follow a dystopia warning may be coded both here and AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: We must ensure that the promise of an AI utopia does not turn into an AI dystopia.
Whether our future will prove to be a blessing or a curse will also depend on how we address perhaps the most consequential development of our time

themes.label: Visionary AI benefits for humanity
themes.definition: Speaker envisions AI delivering transformative benefits: longer healthier lives, personalized medicine and education, abundance, clean energy, ending scarcity.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing concrete human benefits AI could bring in health, food, energy, education or prosperity.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages mentioning AI only as a national sector or cooperation field.
themes.boundary_cases: Short fragments continuing a benefit list (e.g., 'healthier, more productive') count if clearly about AI outcomes.

examples.quote: Let us imagine that we can achieve the end of scarcity, something that has eluded humankind for all history.
healthier, more productive and peaceful lives. That is in our reach.

themes.label: Israel as leading AI nation
themes.definition: Speaker presents the own country as among the few nations spearheading AI and innovations benefiting humanity.
themes.inclusion: Include claims of national AI leadership, pioneering, or national AI contributions to the world.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general statements on global AI development without national claims.
themes.boundary_cases: Statements that AI will be led by a handful of nations may also relate to AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION, but here are framed approvingly.

examples.quote: For good or bad, the developments of AI will be spearheaded by a handful of nations. And my country, Israel, is already among them.
We pioneer incredible developments in health, agriculture, artificial intelligence, superior intelligence

themes.label: Responsible, ethical, human-centred AI
themes.definition: Calls for AI to be shaped responsibly and ethically, preserving human freedom, intuition and empathy.
themes.inclusion: Include passages urging responsible/ethical AI or stressing irreplaceable human values alongside machines.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages focused only on AI benefits or national leadership.
themes.boundary_cases: A call for leaders to jointly shape AI may also be coded AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: Let us cherish and preserve the human capacity for empathy, which no machine can replace.
to shape the great changes before us, but to do so in a responsible and ethical way

themes.label: Leading nations jointly addressing AI dangers
themes.definition: Calls for leading nations to act together and quickly to address AI dangers.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for international collective action to manage AI risks.
themes.boundary_cases: If the call names UN mechanisms, also code AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: The world’s leading nations, however competitive, must address those dangers. We must do so quickly, and we must do so together.

themes.label: AI as field of diplomatic cooperation
themes.definition: AI listed among sectors offered for bilateral or regional cooperation as a benefit of peace or normalization.
themes.inclusion: Include passages listing AI as a cooperation field or technology benefit of diplomatic partnerships.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that discuss AI's nature, risks or governance.
themes.boundary_cases: If only a list of technologies without cooperation framing, use AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: Our two countries could cooperate on energy, water, agriculture, artificial intelligence and many, many other fields.
cooperating with Israel will provide them with groundbreaking Israeli technologies, including in medicine and science, in agriculture and water, in defense and AI

value.rationale: Israel's 2023 speech offers an extended AI segment framing AI as blessing or curse with visionary benefits and a call for responsible joint action; later speeches mention AI only as a national achievement or a field of cooperation offered to peace partners.
